title: SHAPER OS universe manifest (V1.13)
description: A universe declares what it is made of. It never copies a brick, and it never leaves anything about a brick to be guessed: every entry states where the brick comes from (source), which layer it belongs to (perimeter), and — when it diverged from a standard brick — what it forked from (Rule 37). The identifier says WHAT; these fields say WHENCE and WHERE.

universe.description: Universe identity. Carries the univ- layer prefix (docs/architecture/NAMING.md).

parent.description: Parent supervisor universe for the fractal hierarchy (Rule 23 & Rule 36).

forkedFrom.description: Repo-level lineage, mandatory for a Rule 33 fork repo: which upstream class repo this one diverged from, cut at which immutable tag. This is what lets shaper verify enforce the mirror rule (Rules 1 & 37).

alerting.description: The declared out-of-band escalation channel (Rule 27). A universe with no declared channel MUST NOT be promoted beyond DEV; the channel is tested at deploy time like any brick.

channel.description: mobile push, mail, Telegram, or an existing prod-alerting relay — whatever actually reaches a human out-of-band.

target.description: Where the channel delivers. Never a real personal address in a tracked example (Boot Contract 10b).

testedAtDeploy.description: Set by the deploy proof once the channel has actually fired. An unverified alert path is an absent alert path (Rule 0G).

dataLifecycle.description: Declared data lifecycle (Rule 31). personalData: false is a valid and common answer, but it must be written, not left silent.

profile.description: A floor (passive|agent) plus options. See docs/architecture/UNIVERSE-PROFILES.md.

intent.description: Path to this universe's own INTENT.md.

context.description: Path to this universe's ctx-* file.

configuration.description: Path to this universe's cfg-* environment template.

shaperOs.description: Path to the base tree, when the universe sits beside it.

ports.description: Port allocations for bricks in this universe.

bricks.description: Bricks this universe assembles. Keys are brick- identities, never bare names.

source.description: Where this brick comes from (Rule 37). base/catalogue: shipped by that repository, consumed by image+tag. fork: inherited from a standard brick and specialised — forkedFrom becomes mandatory. native: a P3 brick scaffolded inside this class repo (the shaper-tool-scaffold path). Nothing is inferred from a path.

perimeter.description: Which layer this brick belongs to (Rule 0A, Rule 37). Perimeter means LAYER, never OWNER — a client-specific brick can be P1.

forkedFrom.description: Brick-level lineage, mandatory when source is fork: the standard package this brick diverged from, at which version (Rule 37).

package.description: The pkg- source package this brick is built from, when the base or the catalogue ships one. A brick that wraps a third-party image declares `upstream` instead — brick-mariadb has no @shaper package, and pretending otherwise would be a lie a test can be made to enforce.

image.description: The img- registry artefact this brick runs as.

intent.description: Path to the generic brick INTENT.md.

role.description: WHY this brick exists in THIS universe.

cognition.description: Cognitive requirement of this brick in this universe (docs/architecture/COGNITION.md). Declarative only: no automatic router reads it yet.

upstream.description: The third-party image this brick wraps, when it is not built from a pkg- package (e.g. docker.io/library/mariadb:11).

bootOrder.description: Layers of brick- keys. Every brick declared above appears exactly once.
